svg.text: Fish market outside the dike: plan preview (north up, 50 m grid; coast, roads and viaduct are the built island's own data)
TODAY
The red lane kinks straight off the crest junction, runs down the sea face and dead-ends behind the hall. No car park, no forecourt.

g.text: expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water

svg.text: PROPOSAL 1: the reviews' layout, drawn to fit
The viaduct is only 10-25 m off this quay, so the hall cannot move south at all: it slides 37 m west, and the truck yard stays 15 m deep (the planner asked for 30-35 m).

g.text: expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water
10 m of water left to the deck at this corner

svg.text: PROPOSAL 2: my own variant, NOT reviewed
The hall moves to the WEST plot, where the viaduct is furthest off, and 26 m south; today's site becomes the forecourt and car park at the foot of the ramp.

g.text: expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water
12 m of water to the deck at this corner, 20 m and more further west

svg.text: PROPOSAL 3: your sketch - one shared yard, hall at the west end, no public car park, the west gap closed

Hall on the west plot, then truck yard, parking and trade parking in one paved strip. Vehicles turn in the yard. The 14-24 m water slot west of the plot is filled; 12 m of new quay in front of the hall.

g.text: berths on the hall's east side
shared yard 196 x 45 m: trucks and cars turn here
expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water
45 m of open water to the deck in front of the hall

svg.text: PROPOSAL 4: proposal 3 pushed east, a large office + cold store, the yard round the whole hall
Hall 20 m further east and 12 m south; office + cold store attached on its east side; one yard along the hall's whole land side and on east to the trade bays. West gap filled, quay 22 m out.

g.text: truck apron along the hall, 31 m deep: berths on the land side
expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water
15 m of water to the deck at this corner, 30 m in front of the hall

svg.text: PROPOSAL 5: one rectangular yard, with the two reviews' changes

A single paved rectangle 274 x 57 m from the dike toe to the old quay line. Buildings stand in its south-west corner, the ramp comes down inside its north-east edge. "Trade" bays merged into the parking.

g.text: truck apron 31 m deep: berths along the buildings
expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water
22 m of water to the deck at this corner, 40 m in front of the hall

svg.text: PROPOSAL 6: the yard reaches the junction - an upper terrace at the dike's height, the quay level below
The east part of the yard is filled up to the crest (+6 m), so the junction opens straight onto it: parking up there, no landing piece. One ramp inside the yard takes trucks down to the hall.

g.text: UPPER TERRACE, level with the dike road (+6 m)
truck apron (quay level): berths along the buildings
expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water
the terrace top is about level with the viaduct deck, 10-25 m away

svg.text: PROPOSAL 7: your marked-up plan as I read it - a full rectangle, no ramp from the T, a new junction at each end

Yard 300 x 57 m with the turning end taken down to the quay line. The existing T keeps three arms. East: a new junction at x 650 and an L-shaped ramp into the yard's east end. West: a ramp up the dike face to a new T.

g.text: truck apron 31 m deep: berths along the buildings
expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water
passes under the expressway ramp decks

svg.text: PROPOSAL 8: mirrored west and east entrances, yard further right

Yard 260 x 57 m at x 350..610. A new junction at each end (x 305 and x 655), each with a level landing and an L-shaped ramp of ~92 m at 6.8 %. The dike road's bend moves about 20 m west so the west junction sits on straight road.

g.text: gap closed, quay 14 m out in front of the hall
truck apron 31 m deep: berths along the buildings
expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water
25 m of water to the deck at the cold store, 30 m at the hall
east end lies under the expressway ramp decks (piers)

svg.text: PROPOSAL 9: proposal 8 with the three reviews' changes - the east ramp clears every pier

East junction moved 12 m west (x 643): the ramp passes north-west of the pier line, no pier moves. Buildings 26 m east for a forecourt at the west gate. Rounded, widened bends. Dike road bend moved 10 m, not 20.

g.text: gap closed; quay 14 m out in front of the hall
truck apron 31 m: berths along the buildings
expressway viaduct, deck 12 m over the water
black dots: piers as built. Nearest to the ramp 15 m
